title.en: The index of a Fibonacci number

description.zh:
斐波那契數列定義如下： $$ \phi_0 = 0, \ \phi_1 = 1, \ \phi_n = \phi_{n-1} + \phi_{n-2} 。 $$ 給定一個整數 \( a \)，確定它在斐波那契數列中的索引，即印出數字 \( n \) 使得 \( \phi_n = a \) 。如果 \( a \) 不是斐波那契數，則輸出 -1。

C++ 注意：對於以零結尾的輸入，請勿包含結尾零。當結果可能是小數時，請使用 double。
description.en:
The Fibonacci sequence is defined as follows: $$ \phi_0 = 0, \ \phi_1 = 1, \ \phi_n = \phi_{n-1} + \phi_{n-2} . $$ Given an integer \( a \), determine its index among the Fibonacci numbers, that is, print the number \( n \) such that \( \phi_n = a \). If \( a \) is not a Fibonacci number, print -1.

C++ note: For zero-terminated input, do not include the terminating zero. Use double when the result may be fractional.

hint.zh: 輸入以 0 結束的題目不要把結尾的 0 納入統計；需要小數結果時使用 double。
hint.en: For zero-terminated input, do not include the terminating zero. Use double when the result may be fractional.
